description:
Here's a description of the line plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between epoch and Word Error Rate (WER) for different fine-tuning types. The x-axis is labeled “epoch” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks at each integer value. The y-axis is labeled “WER” and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 70, with tick marks at intervals of 10.  A black solid line, representing “tiny AdaLoRA_int4”, begins at approximately 68 at epoch 0 and declines to approximately 41 at epoch 6. A gray dashed line, representing “tiny AdaLoRA_int8”, starts at approximately 64 at epoch 0 and decreases to approximately 40 at epoch 6. A light gray dotted line, representing “tiny int4”, begins at approximately 56 at epoch 0 and declines to approximately 38 at epoch 6. A dark gray dashed line, representing “tiny int8”, starts at approximately 52 at epoch 0 and declines to approximately 32 at epoch 6. Finally, a light purple solid line, representing “tiny”, begins at approximately 32 at epoch 0 and increases slightly to approximately 35 at epoch 6.
